{{Skill}}
==Cards==
The Stats provided by Cooking items are treated as already being at maximum value, including hearts gained from gifting to [[Villagers]].<br>What this means is that cards that affect cooking item Stats will calculate off of the item's current value. There are also no Echoes improvement cards for cooking, only cards that add Echoes. When viewing the table, refer to the bonus descriptions here:

*'''Utility Bonuses'''
**Echoes Find, EXP Gain, Skill EXP Gain, Light Radius 
*'''Offensive Bonuses''' 
**Global attack, Global damage%, Crit Rate, Crit damage, Elemental Effect Chance, Elemental Effect Potency, Global Attack Speed, Armor Penetration, Damage Balance, Skill Range %, Accuracy
*'''Defensive Bonuses'''
**Instant heal MP, Instant heal HP, Knockback Res, Max HP%, Max MP%, HP regeneration per tick, MP regeneration per tick, Chance MP gain per hit, Chance MP gain per hit
*'''Gathering Bonuses'''
**Special Node Chance, Frenzy Node Chance
*'''Crafting Bonuses'''
**More Turns, More Rerolls
